title: Can you change the income tax regime while filing ITR? Here's what taxpayers should know
text: Salaried taxpayers can switch between the old and new tax regimes while filing their ITR, regardless of the regime used by their employer for TDS. However, rules differ for those with business income. Understanding the flexibility and tax impact can help taxpayers make an informed choice.

title: EPF Scheme 2026: Got married? Your past PF nomination is now invalid — key FAQs answered
text: Your earlier EPF nomination becomes invalid once you get married. Filing a fresh nomination ensures your PF benefits are paid to the intended beneficiaries without unnecessary delays or legal complications.

title: Multi-asset allocation funds lead hybrid category inflows: Why investors are rushing in and what to check
text: Multi-asset allocation funds topped the hybrid category, recording ₹70,819 crore in net inflows in 12 months. These funds help diversify across equities, debt, gold, and other assets. Investors should evaluate allocation strategy, diversification, and capture ratios before investing.

title: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana: ₹2,500 monthly assistance announced; Check eligibility, rules and documents
text: The Delhi government has launched the 'Delhi Lakshmi Yojana', providing eligible women with monthly financial assistance of ₹2,500, of which ₹1,500 will go into a locked savings account. The initiative aims to empower women financially and support family stability.

title: Crude prices extend decline, fall over 5% on US-Iran talks optimism; Brent down 20% in three sessions
text: Crude oil prices fell over 5% on Tuesday, driven by hopes of a US-Iran diplomatic breakthrough, easing supply disruption fears. Brent crude dropped to $80.67 and WTI to $77.83, continuing a downward trend after recent military de-escalation and renewed diplomatic efforts in the region.

title: Pentagon blacklist of CXMT: Is Washington accidentally creating a stronger Chinese chip rival?
text: CXMT's shares soared 466% on its Shanghai Stock Exchange debut, elevating its market value to 3.28 trillion yuan. Amid US sanctions, CXMT faces challenges but also an incentive to strengthen its domestic chip production capabilities, impacting the global DRAM market.

title: Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold and silver slide as stronger dollar, Fed uncertainty weigh
text: Gold and silver prices faced selling pressure as investors awaited the US Federal Reserve's policy meeting. A stronger US dollar and rising interest rate expectations impacted precious metals, while geopolitical tensions eased, creating a complex market environment for investors.

title: Coal India Q1 capex rises 16.6% YoY to ₹3,399 crore, beats quarterly target
text: Coal India's June quarter capex reached ₹3,399 crore, marking a 16.6% YoY rise and surpassing targets. Investments in land acquisition and renewable energy were notable, alongside a slight increase in consolidated profit, despite a considerable rise in operating expenses.

title: Fusion Finance forfeits unpaid rights shares after final reminder
text: Fusion Finance forfeited 1.63 lakh partly paid rights shares worth Rs 1.07 crore after investors failed to pay despite the final reminder. The company converted 2.29 lakh shares into fully paid-up equity shares after receiving Rs 1.50 crore in call money.

title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
text: Indian equities ended lower on Tuesday as Sensex and Nifty erased early gains after a sharp rally. Analysts cited cautious sentiment ahead of global central bank meetings, while IT stocks outperformed and Nifty remained range-bound near key technical levels.

title: Market Trading Guide: Bajaj Auto among 4 stock recommendations for Wednesday
text: Indian markets ended slightly lower after Tuesday’s consolidation, but analysts identified four stocks with strong technical setups. Bajaj Auto, 63 Moons Technologies, Ather and Eternal show bullish patterns, with defined entry levels, stop losses and upside targets for traders.

title: Iran threatens to block ships in Strait of Hormuz over Trump's plan to use frozen assets for compensation payments
text: The warning came after US President Donald Trump said future damages to ships, cargo and related maritime assets would be paid using Iranian funds held and controlled by Washington.

title: NEET UG paper leak case: CBI chargesheets 13 accused, Delhi Court to hear matter on Wednesday
text: The CBI has filed a chargesheet against 13 accused in the NEET UG paper leak case, while keeping its investigation into the role of NTA officials open.

title: 13 Indian sailors trapped on vessel at Ukraine’s Chornomorsk Port amid drone attacks, union seeks urgent evacuation
text: In a post on social media platform X, FSUI said M.V. AMIR1, currently docked at the Ukrainian port of Chornomorsk, has 15 crew members on board, including 13 Indian seafarers, who are facing a “terrible and life-threatening situation.”

title: After Elon Musk's ‘money won’t matter in 2036’ remark, Nobel economist asks him to ‘donate $1 trillion to charity then’
text: Elon Musk's comments have resurfaced after Nobel Prize-winning economist Acemoglu publicly challenged him over his views on artificial intelligence and wealth.
